function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (as of 2026).  It covers companies that produce licensed vaccines for routine immunisation, pandemic response, and specialty/biologic products.  For each company I’ve added a short note on their flagship products, geographic focus, and any recent high‑profile developments.

| # | Company | Headquarters | Flagship Vaccines / Product Lines | Notes |
|---|---------|--------------|-----------------------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19 mRNA; HPV, influenza, RSV (in development) | First mRNA vaccine to receive WHO emergency use listing (EUL). Strong global distribution network. |
| 2 | **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – COVID‑19; RSV, influenza, malaria (in development) | Rapid mRNA platform; expanding into non‑COVID indications. |
| 3 | **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Brunswick, USA | Ad26.COV2.S (Janssen COVID‑19); HPV, meningococcal, influenza | Single‑dose adenoviral vector platform; strong presence in low‑resource settings. |
| 4 | **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | NVX-CoV2373 (COVID‑19 protein subunit); influenza, RSV (in development) | Protein‑based vaccine with adjuvant; high efficacy in trials. |
| 5 | **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222) – COVID‑19; HPV, influenza, malaria (in development) | Adenoviral vector platform; large global supply agreements. |
| 6 | **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | MenB, MenACWY, HPV, influenza, COVID‑19 (SARS‑CoV‑2) | One of the largest vaccine producers; strong presence in Europe and Africa. |
| 7 | **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | Shingrix (herpes zoster), HPV, influenza, COVID‑19 (CoVLP) | Focus on recombinant protein and adjuvanted vaccines. |
| 8 | **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | Gardasil (HPV), RotaTeq (rotavirus), COVID‑19 (mRNA‑1273) | Global immunisation portfolio; strong R&D pipeline. |
| 9 | **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Covaxin (BBV152) – COVID‑19; typhoid, rotavirus (in development) | Indigenous inactivated virus platform; large domestic market. |
|10 | **COVAX (Consortium)** | Global | Multiple manufacturers (incl. Pfizer, Moderna, Novavax, Bharat Biotech, etc.) | WHO‑led initiative to ensure equitable access to COVID‑19 vaccines. |
|11 | **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | CoronaVac – inactivated COVID‑19; influenza, rabies | Large domestic market; expanding into Africa and Latin America. |
|12 | **Sinopharm (China National Pharmaceutical Group)** | Beijing, China | BBIBP‑CorV – inactivated COVID‑19; influenza, hepatitis B | State‑owned; extensive distribution in China and partner countries. |
|13 | **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer‑BioNTech)** | Mainz, Germany | Same as Pfizer‑BioNTech | Handles European manufacturing and regulatory affairs. |
|14 | **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Polio, measles‑rubella, hepatitis B, COVID‑19 (Covishield) | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume; key partner for WHO’s Gavi. |
|15 | **Takeda Pharmaceutical** | Tokyo, Japan | Shingrix (licensed from GSK), HPV, influenza | Strong presence in Asia; expanding into global markets. |
|16 | **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Ingelheim, Germany | Influenza, RSV (in development) | Focus on biologics and specialty vaccines. |
|17 | **GSK Vaccines (UK)** | Brentford, UK | Shingrix, HPV, influenza, COVID‑19 (CoVLP) | See #7. |
|18 | **Bayer HealthCare** | Leverkusen, Germany | HPV, influenza, COVID‑19 (in development) | Emerging vaccine portfolio. |
|19 | **Celltrion** | Seoul, South Korea | RSV, influenza (in development) | Biologic platform; expanding into vaccine space. |
|20 | **Zydus Cadila** | Ahmedabad, India | Typhoid, rotavirus, COVID‑19 (in development) | Growing presence in emerging markets. |

### How to Use This List

1. **Research or Investment** – If you’re looking into vaccine R&D pipelines, focus on companies with active clinical programs (e.g., Novavax, Moderna, GSK).
2. **Supply Chain & Procurement** – For public health agencies, consider the geographic reach and manufacturing capacity (e.g., Serum Institute, Bharat Biotech).
3. **Regulatory & Licensing** – Note which companies hold WHO EULs or have FDA/EMA approvals for specific vaccines.
4. **Emerging Players** – Keep an eye on newer entrants like Celltrion or Zydus Cadila, which are scaling up production for global markets.

Let me know if you’d like deeper details on any particular manufacturer, their financials, or upcoming product launches!
